    Reference Image Overlay
    Load one or more reference photos and overlay them on the viewport to help match the camera framing. Overlays are not part of the 3D scene and never export with the model or WebM.
    No reference images loaded
    Keyframe Timeline
    The compact docked timeline has separate Camera, Model, Cards, Dummy, Lighting and Bones tracks. Only a few rows are shown at once: use the vertical scrollbar for hidden layers and the horizontal scrollbar for later or zoomed keyframes. Select a layer, move the playhead, then add a key. Drag keys left or right to retime them; select a key and use Delete Key (or the Delete key on the keyboard) to remove it. Record All captures every available layer at once.
